title: Amateur benefits, a car accident and the Prelude magazine
summary: Clippings of benefit shows she staged in small towns and an accident move; the interviewer finds Sanger's Prelude magazine.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
